# Security current status

Plot the ENSU-based security current status (percent who feel safe living in their city: `100 - pct_unsafe`) by OHI GoC region, using standard `rgn_labels` and `rgn_colors`.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# region labels and colors (same as other SP / CCE scripts)
rgn_labels <- c(
  "Region_1" = "Western Upper Gulf",
  "Region_2" = "Western Midriff Islands",
  "Region_3" = "Western Central Gulf",
  "Region_4" = "Western Southern Gulf",
  "Region_5" = "Eastern Upper Gulf",
  "Region_6" = "Eastern Midriff Islands",
  "Region_7" = "Southern Sonora Coast",
  "Region_8" = "Sinaloa Coast",
  "Region_9" = "Southeastern Gulf"
)

rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

region_levels <- paste0("Region_", 1:9)
rgn_label_colors <- setNames(
  unname(rgn_colors[region_levels]),
  unname(rgn_labels[region_levels])
)

# paths
path_security <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/ss/security_output/cs_security.csv"
path_viz <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/sp/cce/v2026/viz"

dir.create(path_viz, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# current status = percent who feel safe (100 - pct_unsafe)
cs_security <- read_csv(path_security, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_id = factor(rgn_id, levels = region_levels),
    region_label = factor(
      unname(rgn_labels[as.character(rgn_id)]),
      levels = unname(rgn_labels[region_levels])
    ),
    year = year_march
  ) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

cs_security
```

```{r}
p_security <- ggplot(
  cs_security,
  aes(x = year, y = current_status, color = region_label, group = rgn_id)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rgn_label_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(cs_security$year))) +
  labs(
    title = "CURRENT STATUS: Security (percent who feel safe in their city)",
    subtitle = "ENSU March; current status = 100 − percent unsafe. Dashed line = ideal (100).",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Current status (0–100)",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_security

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_viz, "security_current_status.pdf"),
  plot = p_security,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
